slides.title: Things gym owners find weirdly pretty:
Every trainer's CPR card good through next year.
slides.body: All of them. Not just the ones you checked.

slides.title: A liability policy renewal confirmation email.
slides.body: Sitting in the inbox you actually read.

slides.title: The fire inspection sign-off, framed by the front desk.
slides.body: Current year. Not the one from before the remodel.

slides.title: A label maker label on the permits folder.
slides.body: Just one folder. In the office. Where it belongs.

slides.label: And the prettiest of all:
slides.title: One list with every expiry date on it.
slides.body: What's on yours? Save this for renewal season.
